title: Gbong Gwom Jos
by: the British administration of Plateau Province
text: Before colonial rule the Berom were autonomous groups with no paramount ruler. The British made a Berom royal court at Riyom, ratified in 1936, and its head became the paramount stool; in 1947 it moved to Jos, and from 1952 the Berom groups were merged under it as the Gbong Gwom Jos.
